newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: BIRZHU MILK H1 SALES CLIMB.
newsitem.headline: BIRZHU MILK H1 SALES CLIMB.

text.p: Lithuania's Birzhu Milk said on Wednesday that its sales for the first six months of this year rose to 51.2 million litas from 43 million litas in the smae period last year.
The company's general director, Vladas Songaila, also told Reuters that the company's sales in June were 9.5 million litas.
He added that the dairy's profit figure for the first six months of 1997 would be released at the end of this week and that it was expected to fall between 2.5 and 3 million litas.
The company said earlier that its profit in the first five months of this year was 1.9 million litas.
The company is one of the three corporates on the Vilnius bourse's elite five member official list.
